$comment: Opt-in SessionStart hook. Inactive by default — shipped empty so enabling auto-recall is an explicit, user-driven step. To activate, add a SessionStart entry that runs `syne recall --recent --max-chars 1500` (a small, capped, project-scoped brief — never a full transcript) and injects its stdout as additional context. Prefer the trigger-gated `syne align` directive over eager session-start loading; only wire this hook if you want a brief on every session. See README → 'Optional: session-start auto-recall'.
